verifications.claim: Documents demonstrating identity are required to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Una prueba de identidad'; R3: 'One proof of identity'; R5: 'One proof of identity'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state one proof of identity is required.

verifications.claim: Documents demonstrating legal presence are required to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Una prueba de presencia legal'; R3: 'One proof of legal presence'; R5: 'One proof of legal presence'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in sources as a requirement.

verifications.claim: A social security number is required to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Un comprobante de su número de Seguro Social (SSN), si se le ha emitido uno'; R3: 'One proof of your Social Security number (SSN), if you have been issued one'; R5: 'One proof of your Social Security number (SSN), if you have been issued one'
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify proof only if issued one; not required to have an SSN.

verifications.claim: Two proofs of residence are required to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Dos pruebas de residencia en Virginia'; R3: 'Two proofs of Virginia residency'; R5: 'Two proofs of Virginia residency'

verifications.claim: Residents under 18 years old must complete a driver's education course to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Si usted es menor de 18años, Usted debe: Completar con éxito un programa aprobado por el estado Programa de Educación Vial'; R3: 'If you are under age 18, you must: Successfully complete a state-approved driver education program'

verifications.claim: People over 18 years old without a prior license must pass a theoretical exam to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Si completó un programa de educación vial, solo necesita tomar el examen de conocimientos de dos partes'; R3: 'you only need to take the two-part knowledge exam'
verifications.reasoning: Knowledge exam (theoretical) required in both options for over 18 without prior license.

verifications.claim: People over 18 years old without a prior license must pass a practical exam to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Si no completó un programa de educación vial... debe tomar... la prueba de habilidades en la carretera'; R3: 'If you did not complete a driver's education program... you must take... the road skills test'
verifications.reasoning: Practical (road skills) test only required if no driver education program completed; not always mandatory.

verifications.claim: The application process for a driver's license in Virginia can be started online through the DMV website.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Complete la Solicitud de Licencia de Conducir, en línea o en papel'; R3: 'Complete the Driver's License Application, online or on paper'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states application can be completed online.

verifications.claim: Certain driver's license procedures in Virginia require an in-person visit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'you must visit a DMV customer service center'; R6: 'renew your license in person EVERY OTHER renewal cycle'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources require in-person for tests, REAL ID, some renewals.

verifications.claim: Driver's licenses in Virginia can be renewed online.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Renew Online or By Mail'; R8: 'you may renew your driver's license or CDL online'

verifications.claim: Driver's licenses in Virginia can be renewed by mail.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Renew Online or By Mail'; R2: 'Renew Online or By Mail'

verifications.claim: Driver's license renewal in Virginia must be done in person every two renewal cycles.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'You must renew your license in person EVERY OTHER renewal cycle'
verifications.reasoning: Matches exactly (every other cycle = every two cycles).

verifications.claim: Starting May 7, 2025, a REAL ID or another approved federal document such as a passport will be required for domestic flights.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'A partir del 7 de mayo de 2025... REAL ID para abordar un vuelo nacional'; R2: 'Effective May 7, 2025... REAL ID driver's license, or other form of approved identification like a U.S. passport'

verifications.claim: Minors under 18 years old must hold a learner's permit for nine months.

verifications.claim: Minors under 18 years old must complete 45 hours of practice driving.

verifications.claim: A driver's license can be renewed online unless the previous renewal was online or by mail or the license is suspended.

verifications.evidence: R2: 'a standard eight year driver's license... costs $32'; R3: '$32 for a standard eight-year license'
